# Shared repository instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) in the repository root. It contains the
architecture, setup/key-handling workflow, provider authorization boundaries,
code conventions and verification commands. Start installation tasks with
[the agent runbook](../docs/agent-runbook.md); the user enters their key in the
ignored `.env`, confirms completion, and the agent verifies presence without
printing secrets. Do not duplicate the shared policy in this file.
